reason: Root review found an unsuccessful Node exit could retain its owned browser group when no outer timeout occurred.
scope: Only after unsuccessful already-reaped Node exit without timeout: one SIGKILL of its owned process group with actual result recorded. No repeat of timeout kill/wait. Driver, inputs, assertions and all bounds unchanged.

         except Exception as exc:
             receipt['error'] = repr(exc)
         finally:
+            if proc is not None and receipt['reaped'] and receipt.get('returncode') != 0 and not receipt['timed_out']:
+                cleanup = dict(process_group=proc.pid, signal='SIGKILL', attempted=True)
+                try:
+                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)

             receipt['elapsed_ns'] = time.monotonic_ns()-started
